events.text: John Paul Jones's Bonhomme Richard defeats HMS Serapis in a naval battle.
Lewis and Clark return to St. Louis from their expedition to the Pacific.
Nintendo is founded in Kyoto as a playing-card company.
The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is proclaimed.
President Truman announces that the Soviet Union has tested an atomic bomb.
Richard Nixon gives his "Checkers" speech on television.
Philharmonic Hall, the first building at Lincoln Center, opens in New York.
NASA loses contact with the Mars Climate Orbiter because of a units mix-up.

deaths.text: Sigmund Freud, Austrian founder of psychoanalysis
